overview: The Wausau Board of Public Works held a brief meeting on September 29th, approving minutes, a parking lot lighting bid, two Community Infrastructure Partners payment requests related to lead service line replacement, and two construction project pay estimates. All items passed unanimously with no debate or public comment.
presiding: Unknown — presiding officer not identified by name in the transcript

discussions.item: Approval of September 22, 2026 Regular Board of Public Works Minutes
discussions.body: A board member moved to approve the minutes and another seconded. The motion passed unanimously with no discussion.

discussions.item: Recommendation on 2026 Parking Lot Lighting Proposals
discussions.body: Staff reported that proposals were opened on September 26 and only one bid was received from Lighting Design Solutions at $14,447 per twin-head pole unit. A staff member identified as Rick confirmed the amount. The board moved to approve the sole bid, which passed unanimously.

discussions.item: Payment Estimate #34 – Community Infrastructure Partners – Lead Service Line Replacement
discussions.body: Staff presented Payment Estimate #34 from Community Infrastructure Partners covering a mix of engineering, construction, and other costs totaling $2,115,477.27 for the lead service line replacement program. The board moved to approve and the motion passed unanimously without debate.

discussions.item: Pay Estimate – Community Infrastructure Partners – Outreach Grant Program (August Work)
discussions.body: Staff described this as a separate pot of money covering outreach costs for work completed in August, totaling $24,882.13. The board approved the payment unanimously with no discussion.

discussions.item: Pay Estimate #11 – 2025 Street Construction Project A, Randolph Street (Hos Suns Incorporated)
discussions.body: Staff explained this is the final pay estimate for all work completed on the Randolph Street project from Cherry Street, with retainage being reduced to $10,000 pending spring restoration verification. The total payment recommended was $160,458.60. The board approved unanimously.

discussions.item: Pay Estimate #1 – 2026 Sidewalk Repair Project B (Pember Companies)
discussions.body: Staff noted this is expected to be the one and only pay estimate for the project until final retainage release, with retainage reduced to $1,000 and a total pay estimate of $97,721. The board approved unanimously with no discussion.

actionItems: Approve the sole bid from Lighting Design Solutions for 2026 parking lot lighting at $14,447 per twin-head pole unit
Approve Payment Estimate #34 from Community Infrastructure Partners for lead service line replacement totaling $2,115,477.27
Approve pay estimate from Community Infrastructure Partners for August outreach grant program costs totaling $24,882.13
Approve Pay Estimate #11 from Hos Suns Incorporated for 2025 Randolph Street construction project totaling $160,458.60 with retainage reduced to $10,000 pending spring restoration verification
Approve Pay Estimate #1 from Pember Companies for 2026 Sidewalk Repair Project B totaling $97,721 with retainage reduced to $1,000
